summary.p: This is a MS held ad the Prajna Pathashala Mandala in Wai, Sattara. This is a multiple-text manuscript, containing at least three different codicological units.
Folios 1-30 contain the text of the Dhātupāṭha edited (pavita) by Bhīmasena. It is complete and contains 30 folios.

Folios 31-66 are written by a different hand and contain the text of the Gaṇapāṭhavivṛti. The text is incomplete, as it misses some text in the beginning and in the middle. The foliation continues from the preceding codicological unit and must have been added by a later hand.
Folios nr. 42-47 contain an unidentifed text on phonetics (śikṣā).
